pairs.difference: A: the bag is large and low on the card (0.467, a little above the real range), with items rising out of it into clear space. It reads at once as a packed bag. Wide empty striped wall and floor remain either side, and the three thin stems shrink at thumbnail size. Wide pink wall and grey ledge stand empty either side, and the thin straw tip is pinned near the top edge, so at thumbnail size it reads as a generic tube. A: the blue machine is a chunky three-quarter block at normal scale (0.422) with a glowing window as a clear focal point.

pattern: Generated cards keep the whole object inside the card: centred, near-symmetrical, shown straight on, with an even safety margin. Real cards push closer, tilt the hero, or let it or its setting run off an edge, so the first read is one bold silhouette. The generated cards break the real-card pattern in three ways. Heroes are slim or small with dead space beside them (p08 plant, p12 tube). A second element competes with the hero (p06 Earth, p09 tower, p04 tail, p02 sparkles). Thin parts disappear at thumbnail size (p06 struts, p10 rings). The evidence is suggestive rather than decisive, and the measured numbers alone don't always separate them: several real-looking cards also fall slightly outside the ranges.
